name: DoubleButter
old_description: As we’ve said from the very beginning, DoubleButter is better. Sure, that phrase and our sorta silly name originated with an offhand comment Dexter made about how he likes his English muffins (with both regular butter and peanut butter). But to us it’s taken on a broader meaning. It means that working here and designing and building furniture we love is better than any career alternative; it means that collaboration, from initial sketch to production, is better than working solo in a silo; it means that the happy mix of complementary materials can make good design great.
type_evidence: designing and building furniture we love
